quiz.q: Which photo setup will best show a gown in a WhatsApp catalogue?
options: Indoor yellow bulb light, busy patterned background
Daylight near a window, plain background, front, back and detail shots
Midday direct sun with heavy filters
quiz.explain: Soft daylight and a plain background show true colour and shape; several angles and close-ups answer buyers' questions.

quiz.q: A client sees a photo of herself in your outfit on your status but never agreed. What principle was broken?
options: Consent before posting a client's image
quiz.explain: Always get a client's permission before posting her photo, and respect a refusal.

quiz.q: A client says your 40,000 naira gown is too expensive. Your total cost is 32,000. Which reply protects your margin best?
options: Refuse to discuss and block her
Offer the gown at 35,000 without lining, which lowers your cost
quiz.explain: Reducing the order (no lining) lowers the cost, so the price drops without cutting your profit. 28,000 and 30,000 are below cost.

quiz.q: Blessing's cost is 14,000 naira per choir gown and she wants a 20% margin. What price per gown should she quote?
Someone sends 60,000 naira for a 40,000 naira order and asks you to refund 20,000 urgently to a different account. What should you do?
options: Refund immediately to the new account
Send your OTP so they can check
Confirm the payment has cleared in your app, then refund only to the same account it came from
Refund in cash to a rider
quiz.explain: This is a common overpayment trick. Wait for the payment to clear and refund only to the sending account.

quiz.q: Ada is fully booked and turning clients away, but her pricing and records are in good order. What is a sensible next step?
options: Cut prices to attract even more clients
Stop keeping records to save time
Start a large ready-to-wear line on credit
Train or hire help, or raise prices, before buying more machines
quiz.explain: When demand exceeds capacity, adding trained hands or raising prices addresses the real constraint. Cutting prices would make the overload worse.

finalQuiz.q: Which business model usually ties up the most money in stock before any sale?
finalQuiz.explain: Ready-to-wear requires buying fabric and sewing before buyers pay, so money sits in stock until it sells.

finalQuiz.q: A gown costs 36,000 naira in total. What price gives a 25% margin?
finalQuiz.explain: 36,000 / 0.75 = 48,000 naira. Adding 25% to cost would give 45,000, which is only a 20% margin.

finalQuiz.q: Why should a tailor include her own hourly labour in the cost of a garment?
options: Otherwise she is working for free and calling her wage 'profit'
So the price looks higher than competitors
It is only needed for ready-to-wear
finalQuiz.explain: If labour is left out, the leftover money is really her wage, and the business makes no true profit.

finalQuiz.q: Monthly overheads are 120,000 naira and Halima sews about 160 hours a month. A blouse takes 4 hours. How much overhead should it carry?
finalQuiz.explain: Overhead rate = 120,000 / 160 = 750 naira per hour; 4 hours x 750 = 3,000 naira.

finalQuiz.q: For a full-package order, what is the minimum the deposit should cover?
options: The fabric, lining and trims you must buy
Nothing, collect everything at the end
finalQuiz.explain: Fabric cut to one client's size cannot be resold, so the deposit should at least cover materials.

finalQuiz.q: Which stage of the order workflow is the best time to correct fit?
options: When the client complains at the party
finalQuiz.explain: At the fitting, seams and hems are not yet finished, so adjustments are quick and leave no marks.

finalQuiz.q: Esther's March money in was 500,000 naira; materials 200,000, helper 60,000 and overheads 110,000. What was her profit before her own wage?
Which statement about a CAC-registered business name is correct?
options: It gives the owner limited liability
It never needs renewal or filing
It can only be registered by a lawyer in person
It files an annual return with CAC, and the owner stays personally liable
finalQuiz.explain: A business name has no separate legal personality, so the owner is personally liable, and it must file annual returns.

finalQuiz.q: An apprentice has been with you for two months. Which task is most appropriate for her stage?
options: Cutting a bride's lace gown alone
Practising straight seams and simple skirts on offcuts
Running the generator indoors at night
finalQuiz.explain: Early stages build skill on offcuts and simple items before client fabric is trusted to her.

finalQuiz.q: In July, 16 of 20 orders due were on time, and 9 of the 20 orders came from returning clients. What are the on-time and repeat client rates?
finalQuiz.explain: 16 / 20 x 100 = 80% on time; 9 / 20 x 100 = 45% repeat clients.

finalQuiz.q: Which WhatsApp Business feature helps you sort chats by order stage such as 'Deposit paid' or 'Ready'?
finalQuiz.explain: Labels let you tag chats by stage so you can see quickly who has paid, who is due for fitting and whose garment is ready.

finalQuiz.q: A client shows a screenshot of a transfer and wants to collect her outfit now. What is the correct action?
options: Confirm the credit in your business banking app first
Ask her for her OTP to check
Release it and check next week
finalQuiz.explain: Screenshots and SMS alerts can be faked. Only release the garment after confirming the money in your banking app.
